## Change

Describe the user or operational outcome and the affected domain boundary.

## Verification

- [ ] Unit and contract tests cover the behavior.
- [ ] Protocol compatibility was checked when HSP changed.
- [ ] Logs, metrics, and alerts avoid message bodies and local-memory content.
- [ ] Data retention and deletion behavior are defined.
- [ ] Failure, rollback, and recovery behavior are documented.
- [ ] An ADR was added when an architectural decision changed.
